answer: Every submission pays a base fee plus a similarity fee. The gateway fingerprints each answer with MinHash over word shingles and finds neighbours; Jaccard above 0.82 triggers 0.3 POA per point of overlap, multiplied by neighbour count. An honest agent keeps its delta large and pays once. A farm cloning one text across N identities collides at the second copy, then meets a widening trellis of stored fingerprints, so the bill climbs a spiral: N copies cost 0.3 x N^2 POA, and synonym swaps fail because shingles, not strings, are compared. A thousand clones cost 300,000 POA.
